reasons.persona_fit: Addresses small-business owners calmly without hype or prohibited CTAs, though referencing handed-over code in the final paragraph is an awkward fit for this audience context.
reasons.clarity: Logically structured and easy to follow on a first read, with clear plain-language explanations of grounded assistants and human-in-the-loop limits.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, bounded next step: isolate one recurring workflow, count rework instances over two weeks, and maintain explicit human approval for high-risk actions.
reasons.factual_grounding: All technical descriptions align with approved evidence, maintaining strict human-in-the-loop boundaries without inventing customer claims or performance numbers.
